patch_description: Add a deterministic hull-anchored portion to the initial population. The normalized objective strongly rewards configurations whose convex hull retains nearly unit area, but purely jittered or uniform starts usually begin with a substantially smaller hull and the differential-evolution objective is based on unnormalized triangle area. Seeding candidates with the four square corners guarantees a unit-area convex hull from the outset, while the remaining nine points retain stratified diversity. These candidates expose high-hull-area basins without forcing all population members into a fixed-corner model.
